title: @bonstewart this is such a wonderful piece. Going to bookmark and really dive deep. I think Antigonish worked because it was a fiercely local response
summary: @bonstewart this is such a wonderful piece. Going to bookmark and really dive deep. I think Antigonish worked because it was a fiercely local response to finding a place in global world. #ProSocialWeb will be no different. We need to root efforts in localisation more than decentralization.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @bonstewart this is such a wonderful piece. Going to bookmark and really dive deep. I think Antigonish worked because it was a fiercely local response to finding a place in global world. #ProSocialWeb will be no different. We need to root efforts in localisation more than decentralization.
